head.title: Best and worst in every category
head.sub: Every dot is a qualified player on the category’s headline number, worse to the left, better to the right; the top three in their tour colour, the bottom three in coral. Tap a category for its top five and bottom three.

groups.label: Off the tee

metric.label: SG off the tee, est.
metric.tip: Our estimate from driving distance and accuracy, in strokes per round against the tour average. Not ShotLink strokes gained: a regression of our round-by-round strokes gained on season statistics.

stats.label: Distance
stats.tip: Average measured drive (ESPN season statistics, PGA Tour, 2017 on).

stats.label: Fairways
stats.tip: Share of fairways hit from the tee.

stats.label: SG/rd
stats.tip: Strokes gained per round against an average field over the window, shrunk toward the peer average.

groups.min: 30+ rounds in two years; PGA Tour season statistics

groups.label: Approach

metric.label: SG approach, est.
metric.tip: Our estimate from greens in regulation, the same way.

stats.label: Greens
stats.tip: Share of greens reached in regulation (par minus two strokes).

stats.label: SG/rd
stats.tip: Strokes gained per round against an average field over the window, shrunk toward the peer average.

groups.min: 30+ rounds in two years; PGA Tour season statistics

groups.label: Around the green

metric.label: SG around the green, est.
metric.tip: Our estimate from sand saves, the same way.

stats.label: Sand saves
stats.tip: Share of greenside bunker shots followed by one putt or holed out.

stats.label: Bogey+
stats.tip: Share of holes played in bogey or worse: lower is better.

stats.label: SG/rd
stats.tip: Strokes gained per round against an average field over the window, shrunk toward the peer average.

groups.label: Putting

metric.label: SG putting, est.
metric.tip: Our estimate from putts per green hit, the same way.

stats.label: Putts/GIR
stats.tip: Putts per green reached in regulation: lower is better.

stats.label: Birdie+
stats.tip: Share of holes played in birdie or better.

stats.label: SG/rd
stats.tip: Strokes gained per round against an average field over the window, shrunk toward the peer average.

notes: Each week's ranking is the one after that week's finished events; Now adds any finished since. A player without a start since keeps the same rating and moves only when others pass.
The top 100 of the ranking (the ranking's own rule: enough recent rounds behind the rating). Colours only tell the lines apart.
Groups: our strokes-gained categories, estimated from PGA Tour season statistics, for the regulars (30+ rounds in two years) who have them.
